Teplice – Sports Games for the Disabled

Our travelling marathon of exhibitions started on Wednesday at the sports games for athletes with disabilities, right away with full firepower of 4 Trial bike riders (Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Matouš Balík, Lukáš Pařízek and Tobík Nenadál as the youngest of the group) plus Dalibor Šulc as a moto-trial rider. The athletes with disabilities ranged from 18 to over 80 years old and were a truly great and grateful audience that appreciated every attempt the guys made. It was great to bring them a little joy and experiences, of which they had plenty at this event thanks to a great organising team.

Mělník – STATECH exhibition

One of this year's first corporate events, at the open days of Statech (forklifts and aerial work platforms), was led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek. There was even jumping over a platform, which surprised the guys when they found out that, when extended, it isn't quite as stable as you'd expect :) Jumping down from it was a bit of a challenge, but Martin Šimůnek, who took it on, managed everything and survived.

Rymice – Felling of the Rymice maypole

After the north of the country we headed to more distant corners of Moravia. On Friday Matouš Balík and Vlasta set off towards Holešov, where the traditional felling of the maypole was taking place in the picturesque village of Rymice. It came down just as they arrived, so the guys saw it hit the road in front of their car. The exhibition then took place by the stage at the local municipal office. The local crowd, young and old, enjoyed the event and cheered like crazy throughout our exhibition. We also battled the slippery surface of the outdoor dance floor in front of the stage, and there were some impressive performances over the final tape from both Matouš and Vlasta.

Zubří – Chocolate Slipper children's sports day

Our team was already in Zubří back in 2017, and the locals chose us again to celebrate the 10th anniversary of this local event. The beautiful athletics grounds of the local school were complemented by sunny, hot weather and a huge turnout of spectators, who even had a grandstand for more comfortable viewing of the rich programme prepared by the organisers. After almost 4 hours of driving, Lukáš Valný and Vlasta took care of the event, riding a 30-minute exhibition including competitions for kids and jumping over the tape. Thanks to everyone for your support, and congratulations to the young athletes on taking part and on their placings.
